'''1999 GenCon OTSD Booster Draft''' was a Star Wars CCG draft held in Milwaukee, Wisconsin on 5 August 1999. [[Jonathan Swenson]] won it. It is known from Jim Li's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d29">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-03-very-long-gen-con-report-wisconsin-8-7-99d29/ very-long-gen-con-report-wisconsin-8-7-99], DeckTech (Jim "Stimmed Jim" Li, 3 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-03-very-long-gen-con-report-wisconsin-8-7-99d29/ GitHub Pages]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261025144728/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-03-very-long-gen-con-report-wisconsin-8-7-99d29/ Internet Archive].</ref> It was played alongside the [[1999 GenCon Open]].

* '''Date:''' 5 August 1999
* '''Site:''' Milwaukee, Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[OTSD Booster Draft]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Jonathan Swenson]]
